title: Hearty Croatian Uni Bake
description: A funky and creamy Croatian dish featuring uni, this bake is a light and delicious option for a low-sodium meal, it is a great way to enjoy the flavors of Croatia without compromising on health
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Roll out the phillo dough and cut it into large squares.
In a bowl, mix together the uni, feta cheese, garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Brush the phillo dough squares with olive oil and place a spoonful of the uni mixture in the center of each square.
Fold the phillo dough squares into triangles and press the edges together to seal.
Place the triangles on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and brush with lemon juice.
Sprinkle chopped parsley over the top of each triangle.
Bake for 25 minutes or until the phillo dough is golden brown.
